all_other_serving_parameters.note: Identical to the corresponding frozen condition in every respect except max_new_tokens for the relations task.

concepts_unchanged.reason: The censoring evidence is specific to relations; concepts showed 95-99% validity at 512 with truncation-associated invalid rates of 0.09-1.04%.
concepts_unchanged.rule: All concept results remain at 512 and are NOT regenerated. Existing frozen concept outputs stay final.

created_utc_source: read from `date -u` immediately before writing (see D-017 erratum for why this is stated)

historical_preservation.reporting: The final report must distinguish HISTORICAL 512 relation results from FINAL 1024 relation results.
historical_preservation.rule: All 512-budget relation results are preserved unmodified as historical artifacts in their original directories and are NEVER overwritten.

name: final_task_specific_generation_budget

regeneration_policy.reason: Final relation results must come from ONE uniform serving budget, not a mixture of 512 and 1024 generations. Selectively repairing only the invalid records would create a budget-heterogeneous cohort.
regeneration_policy.rule: All 1,062 slides are regenerated for each corrected relation condition.

scientific_justification.claim: Relation outputs are systematically longer than concept outputs, and the 512-token ceiling non-randomly censors high-yield slides.

evidence_pilot100.interpretation: 1024 is a completion-budget correction, not a change in relation-extraction behaviour.

scientific_justification.residual_limitation: 1024 does NOT eliminate all truncation: 1-3 records per affected cell remained truncated at 1024 on Pilot-100. No claim of complete elimination is made.

status: FROZEN BEFORE ANY NEW INFERENCE UNDER THIS PROTOCOL

applies_to: all models in the final panel
symmetry_requirement.explicitly_not: This is NOT a Qwen-specific rescue. The 1024 relation budget was validated on, and is applied to, the two incumbent models that ALREADY PASSED the original gate, and both of which also fail a relations-only 95% bar at 512.
symmetry_requirement.rule: The task-specific budget is applied to ALL models and ALL relation perturbation conditions used in the final analysis.
